release_notes:
Star Soft Enterprise v4.0.65 Release Notes (19-Nov-2026 11:15 AM):
- Separated DB (62126), Android API (5088), and Browser Web Client (5090) ports across StarSoft Server, StarPortConfig, and StarMaster.
- Added Customer Profile (360° + Collect Payment Receipt), Supplier Profile (+ Pay Voucher), Bill Settlement (with History & Full Balance dock), and User Profile to Browser Web Client v1.8.0.
- Removed Web Monitor Email settings card and excluded Browser Web clients from Desktop Employee Monitor.
- Renamed POS Billing to Inventory Billing across Desktop, Web, and Android (v1.8.0 / Build 10).
- Added conflict-free live Next Bill No sync and configurable per-platform Idle Auto-Close timeouts (default 5 mins).
